theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_dtfr_face_integral_current
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (s : Finset ((Fin (m + 1) → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ))) (w : (Fin (m + 1) → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ) → Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ), (∀ p ∈ s, StrictMono p.1) → (∀ p ∈ s, IntegrableOn (w p) {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), ∀ p ∈ s, IntegrableOn (fun y => w p y * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ))) {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}) ∧ (∃ D : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), D ω = ∑ p ∈ s, ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, w p y * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ))) ∧ ∀ D : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), D ω = ∑ p ∈ s, ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, w p y * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ))) → D.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∑ p ∈ s, ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, |w p y|) ∧ (∀ B : (Fin (m + 1) → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ) → ℝ, (∀ p ∈ s, ∀ G : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) G → (∀ y, ‖G y‖ ≤ 1) → |∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, w p y * LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ G y)| ≤ B p) → D.boundary.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∑ p ∈ s, B p)) ∧ (∀ x ∈ D.support, ∃ p ∈ s, (∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, |w p y|) ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ y : Euclid (m + 1), (∀ i, 0 ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ 1) ∧ (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) = x)
